title: Prepositions of time and place
titleVi: Giới từ chỉ thời gian và nơi chốn
summary: at/on/in cho thời gian, during/for/while, by/until, và in/on/at cho nơi chốn — nền tảng của mọi mô tả Task 1.
whyItMatters: Task 1 là bài mô tả thời gian và vị trí, nên giới từ sai làm câu mô tả sai: *in 2010* đúng, *on 2010* sai; *during three years* sai, *for three years* đúng. Ở band 6, lỗi giới từ xuất hiện vài lần mỗi đoạn và khiến người đọc phải dừng lại. Sửa nhóm này là cách nhanh nhất để câu văn trôi.

sections.heading: at, on, in for time
body: Think of it as a scale from **point** to **surface** to **container**. **At** marks a point in time: *at 7 o'clock*, *at noon*, *at midnight*, *at the weekend* (British English), *at Christmas*. **On** marks a day or date: *on Monday*, *on 3 May*, *on my birthday*, *on New Year's Day*.
**In** marks a longer period — month, year, season, decade, century, or part of the day: *in July*, *in 2019*, *in winter*, *in the 1990s*, *in the morning*. The main exception is **at night**.
Fixed phrases to memorise: *in the morning / afternoon / evening*, **but** *at night*; *on Monday morning*; *in time* (early enough) versus *on time* (punctual).

sections.heading: during, for, while; by and until
body: **During + noun** answers *when*: *during the recession*, *during the 1990s*. **For + period** answers *how long*: *for three years*, *for a decade*. **While + clause**: *while the economy was growing*.
A quick test: if you can ask *how long?*, use **for**; if you can ask *when?*, use **during**. *During three years* fails the test because *three years* is a length, not a point.

**By** = not later than (a deadline): *The target should be met by 2030.* **Until** = continuing up to (a stop): *The scheme ran until 2015.* So *by 2015* means at some point before 2015; *until 2015* means it continued and then stopped.

examples.right: House prices doubled during the pandemic.
examples.wrong: House prices doubled for the pandemic.

examples.right: The programme ran for six years.
The figure is projected to reach 40% by 2030.
examples.wrong: The figure is projected to reach 40% until 2030.
examples.note: **by** = deadline; *until* would mean it stays at 40% up to 2030.

sections.heading: in, on, at for place
body: **In** = inside a space or area: *in the room*, *in Hanoi*, *in Vietnam*, *in the north of the country*. **On** = on a surface or along a line: *on the table*, *on the wall*, *on the coast*, *on the second floor*, *on the left*.

**At** = at a point or at a place seen as a point of activity: *at the station*, *at the airport*, *at school*, *at work*, *at home*, *at the corner*. This is why *at school* means attending school, while *in the school* means physically inside the building.
For cities, countries and regions use **in**; for a precise address use **at**: *at 25 Tran Hung Dao Street*. For transport, **on** a bus/train/plane, **in** a car/taxi.

sections.heading: Describing position in Task 1 maps and charts
body: Maps and location descriptions need precise spatial phrases: *in the north of the city*, *to the south of the river*, *on the eastern edge*, *along the coast*, *at the junction of two roads*.
Note the difference between **in the north of** (inside the area) and **to the north of** (outside it): *Hanoi is in the north of Vietnam*, but *Haiphong lies to the east of Hanoi*.
For change over time on a map, combine place and time: *In 1990, the site to the west of the station was farmland; by 2020 it had become a car park.*

examples.right: The new housing estate lies to the south of the river.
examples.note: **to the south of** = outside but on that side.

examples.right: The factory is on the eastern edge of the town.
In 2005, the area at the junction of the two roads was undeveloped.
examples.wrong: In 2005, the area in the junction of the two roads was undeveloped.

sections.heading: The preposition errors worth memorising
body: Some phrases are fixed and cannot be reasoned out: *in the end* (finally) versus *at the end of* (at the final point); *on time* (punctual) versus *in time* (early enough); *at present* versus *in the present*.
Learn these as whole units, not as preposition + noun. A short list of ten fixed phrases will cover most of what Task 1 and Task 2 require.
When you are unsure in the exam, choose the simpler structure: *in 2019* rather than *in the year of 2019*, *for ten years* rather than *during ten years*.

examples.right: In the end, the council approved the plan.
examples.wrong: At the end, the council approved the plan.
examples.note: **in the end** = finally; *at the end* needs *of + noun*.

examples.right: We arrived in time to catch the last bus.

commonMistakes.why: Năm dùng **in**, không dùng *on*. *On* chỉ dùng cho ngày hoặc thứ.
**during** + danh từ chỉ khoảng thời gian cụ thể (*during the recession*); độ dài thời gian dùng **for**.

commonMistakes.wrong: The target must be reached until 2030.
commonMistakes.right: The target must be reached by 2030.
commonMistakes.why: **by** = không muộn hơn một mốc; **until** = tiếp diễn đến mốc đó rồi dừng.
**at university** = đang theo học (hoạt động); *in the university* = ở bên trong toà nhà.

commonMistakes.wrong: There is a new bridge in the river.
commonMistakes.right: There is a new bridge over the river. / across the river.
commonMistakes.why: Cầu nằm **bên trên** dòng sông, không nằm trong nước. Giới từ không gian phải khớp với quan hệ thật.

ieltsTips: Trong Task 1, dùng **from … to …** và **between … and …** cho khoảng thời gian, và **by** cho mốc dự báo: *Between 2000 and 2010, sales doubled; **by** 2030, they are expected to triple.*
Với biểu đồ có mốc thời gian mở, dùng **since + mốc** và **over + khoảng**: *Since 2015, rents have risen sharply; **over** the past decade, the gap has widened.*

Trong Task 1 map, dùng **to the north/south/east/west of** khi vị trí nằm ngoài khu vực đang mô tả, và **in the north of** khi nằm bên trong: *The station is **to the east of** the park, while the market lies **in the north of** the town.*

Học thuộc mười cụm cố định thay vì học quy tắc: **in the end / at the end of**, **on time / in time**, **at night / in the morning**, **at the weekend**, **on the coast**, **in the north of**. Chúng xuất hiện gần như mọi bài Task 1.
